content.what_it_is: MATLAB diagnostic-movie script for the FUNWAVE-TVD sediment lab benchmark (car_sediment_lab_c2). Reads bathymetry dep.out from fdir_results='/Users/fengyanshi/TMP/tmp3/' (L4, L8-9); 1D profile axis x=[0:m-1]*0.06 m (L13); snapshot indices files=[33:150] (L15). Creates MPEG-4 VideoWriter videoOut.mp4, FrameRate=10, Quality=100 (L18-23); 16x12-inch figure, jet colormap (L25-30). Per snapshot loop (L32-318): loads 15 transposed fields per index fnum ('%.5d', L36): eta_, u_, mask_ (L39-47), sediment bed-change DchgS_ (Ds), DchgB_ (Db) (L49-54), concentration C_ (L56-58), updated depth dep_ (L60-62), pickup Pick_ (L64-66), deposition Depo_ (L68-70), averaged pickup Pavg_ (L72-74), reference concentrations Ca_/Cb_ (L76-82), bed stress BedStr_ (str, L84-86), excess stress TauEx_ (L88-90), avalanche Aval_ (L92-94), porous depth Hpo_ (L96-98). Masks dry cells to NaN (L102-103); Froude number Fr=abs(u)./sqrt(9.81*(dep'+eta)) (L105). Recomputes sediment constants for cross-check ('% check' L112): D50=0.00012, WS=0.07, Sdensity=2.68, grav=9.8, viscosity=0.000001, Shields_cr=0.05 (L114-119), k_s=2.5*D50 (L120), Tau_cr=(Sdensity-1)*grav*D50*Shields_cr (L121), and Tau_xy=0.16./(1+log(k_s./(30*Hpo))).^2.*u.^2 (L125) mirroring sediment.F formulas. Draws an 8x3 diagnostic panel grid, each quantity with a full-domain [0 65] panel and a surf-zone zoom [34 44]: eta+depth (L131-156), u+Froude (L158-173), Pickup (L175-192), Depo (L195-210), C (L212-227), Cb vs Ca ('Cb','capped Cb' L250) (L230-250), log10 bed stress vs log10(Tau_cr) line (L253-278), bed-change components Ds/Db/Aval and totals (L280-306; full panel sums Ds+Db+Aval L286, zoom sums only Ds+Db L299 with legend 'Tot'). Captures each frame via print('-RGBImage','-r300') (L312) into mov(k) and writeVideo (L316); closes video (L320).

equations.ref: bed shear check formula (mirrors sediment.F tau_xy)

calls: clear all @L1; load @L9, @L40-L98; size @L10; VideoWriter @L18; open @L23; figure @L25; colormap @L26; set @L30; sprintf @L36; sqrt/abs @L105; log @L125; clf @L129; subplot/plot/hold/grid/axis/xlabel/ylabel/legend/title @L131-L306; num2str @L141, @L155; log10 @L255, @L259, @L269, @L273; pause @L308; print('-RGBImage','-r300') @L312; writeVideo @L316; close @L320
unresolved: The zoom bed-change panel sums only Ds+Db (L299) while labeling the red curve 'Tot' (L303); the full-domain panel includes Aval (L286) -- inconsistent totals between panels.

Sediment constants are re-hardcoded here (L114-121: D50=0.00012, WS=0.07, Sdensity=2.68, Shields_cr=0.05; grav=9.8 vs 9.81 in Fr L105) as a manual cross-check of sediment.F output; whether they match the actual input.txt of this benchmark run cannot be verified from this file.
Tau_xy (L125) and TauEx (L88-90), picka/Pavg (L72-74), uu/etaa (L100-101), WS and viscosity (L115, L118) are computed/loaded but never plotted or used.
fdir_results is a hard-coded personal path (L4); snapshot numbering files=[33:150] with '%.5d' names and frame time labeled as 'numb s' (L141) assumes 1-s output intervals -- not derivable here.
Panels 8,3 index 16/17-18 plot Cb then Ca but the legend calls Ca 'capped Cb' (L250); axis for zoom panel L247 uses [0 65] not the [34 44] zoom of its siblings.
